title: 2012 HMMT February Guts Problem 14
statement: Let triangle \(A B C\) have \(A B=5, B C=6\), and \(A C=7\), with circumcenter \(O\). Extend ray \(A B\) to point \(D\) such that \(B D=5\), and extend ray \(B C\) to point \(E\) such that \(O D=O E\). Find \(C E\).

solutions.text: \(\sqrt{59}-3\) Because \(O D=O E, D\) and \(E\) have equal power with respect to the circle, so \((E C)(E B)=(D B)(D A)=50\). Letting \(E C=x\), we have \(x(x+6)=50\), and taking the positive root gives \(x=\sqrt{59}-3\).
